pack-all.//: Packs all packable projects in the workspace. src/ lands in dist/packages/ (flat); others go under dist/packages/<relative-path>/

_inject_template_version.//: Stamps the current Directory.Build.props version into all starter template.json files

_inject_agents_md.//: Copies the canonical AGENTS.md into each starter template before packing

commands: for dir in examples/starter/*/; do cp docs/guides/misc/AGENTS.md "$dir"; done
